#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a cover page PDF for the Annual Financial Report."""
import datetime
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# Letter size at 300 DPI
W, H = 2550, 3300
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "white")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Try to load a nice TrueType font; fall back to Pillow's default.
def load_font(path, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except Exception:
        return None

title_font = None
for path in (
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/freefont/FreeSansBold.ttf",
):
    title_font = load_font(path, 140)
    if title_font:
        break
if title_font is None:
    title_font = ImageFont.load_default(140)

date_font = None
for path in (
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/freefont/FreeSans.ttf",
):
    date_font = load_font(path, 72)
    if date_font:
        break
if date_font is None:
    date_font = ImageFont.load_default(72)

title = "Annual Financial Report"
today = datetime.date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# Draw title centered
bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), title, font=title_font)
tw, th = bbox[2] - bbox[0], bbox[3] - bbox[1]
draw.text(((W - tw) / 2 - bbox[0], H * 0.35 - bbox[1]), title, fill="black", font=title_font)

# Draw date centered below the title
bbox2 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), date_str, font=date_font)
dw, dh = bbox2[2] - bbox2[0], bbox2[3] - bbox2[1]
draw.text(((W - dw) / 2 - bbox2[0], H * 0.35 + th + 90 - bbox2[1]), date_str, fill="black", font=date_font)

# A subtle rule line under the title area
draw.line([(W * 0.2, H * 0.35 + th + 150), (W * 0.8, H * 0.35 + th + 150)], fill="black", width=6)

img.save("cover.pdf", "PDF", resolution=300.0)
print("Wrote cover.pdf")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepend cover.pdf to report.pdf, writing the result back to report.pdf."""
import os
import shutil
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Back up the original file first
if not os.path.exists("report_original_backup.pdf"):
    shutil.copyfile("report.pdf", "report_original_backup.pdf")
    print("Backed up original to report_original_backup.pdf")

cover_reader = PdfReader("cover.pdf")
report_reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")

writer = PdfWriter()
# Add the cover page (must be first)
for page in cover_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
# Add all original report pages
for page in report_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

# Write to a temp file, then move over report.pdf (avoids clobbering mid-read)
with open("report_merged_tmp.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

shutil.move("report_merged_tmp.pdf", "report.pdf")
print(f"Wrote report.pdf with {len(cover_reader.pages) + len(report_reader.pages)} pages "
      f"({len(cover_reader.pages)} cover + {len(report_reader.pages)} original)")
